# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Saturday, November 7, 2026

Morning edition for Saturday, 7 November 2026 (IST). Covers 6 Nov session and overnight. Indian equity markets closed today.

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

### RBI: NBFC credit up 15.4%; gold-jewellery loans up 66.1% to ₹3.74 lakh crore
RBI's 6 Nov release on sectoral deployment of NBFC credit for September 2026 shows overall NBFC (incl. HFC) credit up 15.4% YoY to ₹61.70 lakh crore, vs 13.3% a year earlier. Within retail, loans against gold jewellery rose 66.1% YoY to ₹3.74 lakh crore; retail loans overall grew 21.9% to ₹26.84 lakh crore.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: official confirmation that gold jewellery is the fastest retail pocket in the Upper and Middle Layer NBFC sample, which sets the system benchmark for gold-loan AUM growth comparisons.
Source: [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63940)

### Update: Muthoot Fincorp Tranche I NCD — allotment due Monday 9 Nov
No new bid or allotment figures since the 5 Nov close at 2.67x. Chittorgarh still shows allotment on 9 Nov and BSE listing on 10 Nov, with allotment-status fields blank as of this morning.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: Monday is the allotment checkpoint versus the ₹500 crore ceiling; listing on Tuesday sets the secondary-market reference for the shelf.
Source: [Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/)


### Muthoot Fincorp NCD status

|---|---|---|
| Status | Closed, 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026; allotment 9 Nov, BSE listing 10 Nov ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/)) | 2026-11-07 |
| Size | ₹500 crore (₹200 crore base + ₹300 crore green shoe), under a ₹4,000 crore shelf; final allotment size not yet published | 2026-11-05 |
| Rating | CRISIL AA/Stable; Brickwork AA+/Stable | 2026-11-05 |
| Coupon | 8.56%–9.25% | 2026-11-05 |
| Bids | 2.67x at 17:00 IST on 5 Nov (retail 2.51x, HNI 3.79x, NII 1.34x, institutional 0.02x) | 2026-11-05 |

### SEBI Settlement Regulations, 2026 commence today (7 Nov)
SEBI PR No.70/2026 (6 Nov) confirms the SEBI (Settlement of Administrative and Civil Proceedings) Regulations, 2026 — notified 8 Oct — come into force on 7 Nov 2026. FAQs, an online settlement-amount calculator and an online application form are live on sebi.gov.in.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: relevant to any future SEBI civil or administrative matter on listed NCDs or related intermediary conduct; not a lending circular.
Source: [SEBI](https://www.sebi.gov.in/media-and-notifications/press-releases/nov-2026/commencement-of-sebi-settlement-of-administrative-and-civil-proceedings-regulations-2026_105680.html)

## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market

### Sensex and FinNifty extend the rally into NCD allotment week
On 6 Nov the Sensex rose 2.17% to 81,028.02 and Nifty Financial Services 2.57% to 27,283.95, a seventh up day for benchmarks into the week Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I is due to allot and list.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: a firm financials tape into allotment and listing week supports the comparison set for the NCD secondary print.
Source: [NSE index closes](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_06112026.csv)

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

### Sensex up 2.17% to 81,028; Nifty 50 reclaims 25,000
The Sensex closed at 81,028.02 on 6 Nov, up 1,718.01 points (2.17%). The Nifty 50 rose 2.01% to 25,030.35 — its first close above 25,000 since 27 Feb 2026, per Business Standard. Nifty Financial Services gained 2.57% to 27,283.95.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: bank and financial shares led the session that sets the tape for Muthoot Fincorp's NCD listing week.
Source: [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/stock-market-live-november-6-nse-bse-sensex-today-nifty50-gift-nifty-crude-oil-prices-q2-results-today-dhanteras-126110600099_1.html)

### Peers: IIFL Finance +3.52%, Bajaj Finance +1.66%, Muthoot Finance +1.06%; Manappuram flat
On NSE, IIFL Finance closed at ₹625.75 (+3.52%), Bajaj Finance at ₹1,087.75 (+1.66%), Muthoot Finance at ₹2,869.00 (+1.06%), Manappuram at ₹325.40 (−0.18%), Shriram Finance at ₹961.15 (−0.30%) and Muthoot Microfin at ₹153.92 (−2.51%).
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: gold-loan peers held most of Thursday's gains; Muthoot Microfin gave back part of its post-results bounce.
Source: [NSE bhavcopy](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_06112026.csv)

### FIIs buy a provisional ₹13,750 crore; DIIs sell ₹5,969 crore
Exchange provisional data cited by Economic Times show FIIs net bought about ₹13,750 crore of Indian equities on 6 Nov, while DIIs net sold about ₹5,969 crore. Moneycontrol's FII/DII page shows ₹13,749.82 crore / −₹5,968.70 crore.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: continued foreign buying into Diwali week supports the equity risk premium around gold-loan peers; it does not change NCD allotment maths.
Source: [Economic Times](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/fiis-step-up-india-buying-pour-rs-13750-crore-on-friday-total-buying-hits-rs-53154-crore-in-14-days/articleshow/135612403.cms)

### Rupee closes at 93.90; Brent settles at $98.32
BusinessLine reports the rupee closed at 93.90 per dollar on 6 Nov, up 57 paise from 94.47 — a six-and-a-half-month high. Brent settled at $98.32 a barrel, barely changed on the day after a sharp weekly drop.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: a firmer rupee and softer oil ease the inflation path priced into bank funding costs for NBFCs.
Source: [BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/forex/rupee-strengthens-to-close-at-a-six-and-a-half-month-high/article71675114.ece)

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

### RBI publishes September NBFC sectoral credit; gold jewellery loans +66.1%
RBI press release (6 Nov, prid=63940): NBFC credit +15.4% YoY in Sep 2026; retail +21.9%; gold jewellery loans called out with accelerated growth.
Source: [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63940)

### SEBI Settlement Regulations, 2026 in force from 7 Nov
SEBI PR No.70/2026 (6 Nov): Settlement of Administrative and Civil Proceedings Regulations, 2026 commence today; calculator and online application live.
Source: [SEBI](https://www.sebi.gov.in/media-and-notifications/press-releases/nov-2026/commencement-of-sebi-settlement-of-administrative-and-civil-proceedings-regulations-2026_105680.html)

### No new NBFC notification on RBI's notifications feed after 5 Nov cyber MD for PSOs
RBI's notifications RSS shows Master Directions on Cyber Resilience for non-bank payment system operators (5 Nov) and no fresh NBFC-lending instrument dated 6 Nov. IBBI, NHB and FIU-IND pages checked; no new NBFC-relevant instrument overnight.
Source: [RBI notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx)

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

No significant new NBFC results overnight beyond items already covered on 5–6 Nov (Muthoot Microfin Q2).

## 🏘️ Sector Deep Dive — Saturday: Infrastructure & project finance

### RBI: infrastructure lending at NBFCs slowed to 5.9% YoY in September
Inside industry credit (up 7.4% YoY to ₹22.69 lakh crore), RBI says infrastructure growth stayed subdued at 5.9% YoY to ₹20.60 lakh crore, vs 9.4% a year earlier; power lending grew 7.9% to ₹14.80 lakh crore. ETBFSI's read of the same release puts infrastructure at those levels and contrasts it with gold jewellery's 66.1% surge.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: none direct on the gold book — system growth is rotating toward retail secured (gold, housing, vehicles) while classic infra NBFCs are the slow pocket.
Source: [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63940)

# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Saturday, 7 November 2026 (IST)

---

## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

### [NEW] RBI publishes September 2026 NBFC sectoral credit; gold jewellery loans +66.1%
RBI on 6 Nov released sectoral deployment of credit by NBFCs (Upper and Middle Layer sample plus HFCs, ~87% of sector credit) for September 2026. Overall credit grew 15.4% YoY to ₹61.70 lakh crore; retail grew 21.9% to ₹26.84 lakh crore. ETBFSI's read of the release puts loans against gold jewellery at ₹3.74 lakh crore, up 66.1% YoY; infrastructure lending grew a subdued 5.9%.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the system gold print is the benchmark for gold-loan AUM growth comparisons across Upper and Middle Layer NBFCs.
Reference: RBI press release (prid=63940) · Addressed to: public (data release on UL/ML NBFCs and HFCs) · Issued: 6 Nov 2026
Source: [RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63940)

### [NEW] SEBI (Settlement of Administrative and Civil Proceedings) Regulations, 2026 commence 7 Nov
SEBI PR No.70/2026 (6 Nov) confirms the Settlement Regulations, 2026 — notified 8 Oct 2026 — come into force on 7 Nov 2026. FAQs, an online settlement-amount calculator, an online application form and a help desk are available on sebi.gov.in. ET reports a 90-day filing window from show-cause (or 90 days from 7 Nov for pending matters), application fees of ₹25,000 (individuals) / ₹35,000 (others), and a settlement-notice route before SCN in some cases.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: not a lending or gold-loan circular. It matters for any future SEBI civil or administrative exposure on listed NCDs or related intermediary conduct.
Reference: PR No.70/2026 · Addressed to: market participants / eligible settlement applicants · Issued: 6 Nov 2026 · Effective: 7 Nov 2026
Source: [SEBI](https://www.sebi.gov.in/media-and-notifications/press-releases/nov-2026/commencement-of-sebi-settlement-of-administrative-and-civil-proceedings-regulations-2026_105680.html)

### No new NBFC-lending circular from RBI notifications, IBBI, NHB or FIU-IND on 6 Nov
RBI's notifications RSS after the 5 Nov Master Directions on Cyber Resilience for non-bank payment system operators has no fresh NBFC-lending instrument dated 6 Nov. IBBI what's-new, NHB notifications and FIU-IND homepage checked this morning; nothing new for gold-loan NBFCs overnight. Bank-facing items on 6 Nov were routine (VRR/VRRR, T-bill and G-sec auctions, FLA census, Bulletin extract, one co-op bank direction).
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: none today beyond the data release and SEBI settlement commencement above.
Source: [RBI notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx)

cards.title: RBI: NBFC credit up 15.4%; gold-jewellery loans up 66.1% to ₹3.74 lakh crore
cards.summary: RBI's 6 Nov release on sectoral deployment of NBFC credit for September 2026 shows overall NBFC (incl. HFC) credit up 15.4% YoY to ₹61.70 lakh crore, vs 13.3% a year earlier.
cards.impact: official confirmation that gold jewellery is the fastest retail pocket in the Upper and Middle Layer NBFC sample, which sets the system benchmark for gold-loan AUM growth comparisons.

cards.title: Update: Muthoot Fincorp Tranche I NCD — allotment due Monday 9 Nov
cards.summary: No new bid or allotment figures since the 5 Nov close at 2.67x. Chittorgarh still shows allotment on 9 Nov and BSE listing on 10 Nov, with allotment-status fields blank as of this morning.
cards.impact: Monday is the allotment checkpoint versus the ₹500 crore ceiling; listing on Tuesday sets the secondary-market reference for the shelf.

cards.title: Muthoot Fincorp NCD status
cards.summary: Field Value As of Status Closed, 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026; allotment 9 Nov, BSE listing 10 Nov (Chittorgarh) 2026-11-07 Size ₹500 crore (₹200 crore base + ₹300 crore green shoe), under a ₹4,000 crore shelf; final allotment size not yet published 2026-11-05 Rating CRISIL AA/Stable; Brickwork AA+/Stable 2026-11-05 Coupon 8.56%–9.25% 2026-11-05 Bids 2.67x at 17:00 IST on 5 Nov (retail 2.51x, HNI 3.79x, NII 1.34x, institutional 0.02x) 2026-11-05

cards.title: SEBI Settlement Regulations, 2026 commence today (7 Nov)
cards.summary: SEBI PR No.70/2026 (6 Nov) confirms the SEBI (Settlement of Administrative and Civil Proceedings) Regulations, 2026 — notified 8 Oct — come into force on 7 Nov 2026. FAQs, an online settlement-amount calculator and an online application form are live on sebi.gov.in.
cards.impact: relevant to any future SEBI civil or administrative matter on listed NCDs or related intermediary conduct; not a lending circular.

cards.title: Sensex and FinNifty extend the rally into NCD allotment week
cards.summary: On 6 Nov the Sensex rose 2.17% to 81,028.02 and Nifty Financial Services 2.57% to 27,283.95, a seventh up day for benchmarks into the week Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I is due to allot and list. Source: NSE index closes
cards.impact: a firm financials tape into allotment and listing week supports the comparison set for the NCD secondary print.

cards.summary: Item Value As of Source NCD Tranche I status Closed 5 Nov 2026; allotment 9 Nov; BSE listing 10 Nov 2026-11-07 Chittorgarh NCD Tranche I size ₹200 cr base + ₹300 cr green shoe = ₹500 cr (₹4,000 cr shelf) 2026-11-05 Chittorgarh NCD Tranche I coupons 8.56%–9.25% 2026-11-05 Chittorgarh NCD Tranche I bids at close Bids stood at 2.67x (retail 2.51x, HNI 3.79x, NII 1.34x, institutional 0.02x) at 17:00 IST 2026-11-05 Chittorgarh Ratings CRISIL AA/Stable · Brickwork AA+/Stable…

cards.title: Sensex up 2.17% to 81,028; Nifty 50 reclaims 25,000
cards.summary: The Sensex closed at 81,028.02 on 6 Nov, up 1,718.01 points (2.17%). The Nifty 50 rose 2.01% to 25,030.35 — its first close above 25,000 since 27 Feb 2026, per Business Standard.
cards.impact: bank and financial shares led the session that sets the tape for Muthoot Fincorp's NCD listing week.

cards.title: Peers: IIFL Finance +3.52%, Bajaj Finance +1.66%, Muthoot Finance +1.06%; Manappuram flat
cards.summary: On NSE, IIFL Finance closed at ₹625.75 (+3.52%), Bajaj Finance at ₹1,087.75 (+1.66%), Muthoot Finance at ₹2,869.00 (+1.06%), Manappuram at ₹325.40 (−0.18%), Shriram Finance at ₹961.15 (−0.30%) and Muthoot Microfin at ₹153.92 (−2.51%). Source: NSE bhavcopy
cards.impact: gold-loan peers held most of Thursday's gains; Muthoot Microfin gave back part of its post-results bounce.

cards.title: FIIs buy a provisional ₹13,750 crore; DIIs sell ₹5,969 crore
cards.summary: Exchange provisional data cited by Economic Times show FIIs net bought about ₹13,750 crore of Indian equities on 6 Nov, while DIIs net sold about ₹5,969 crore. Moneycontrol's FII/DII page shows ₹13,749.82 crore / −₹5,968.70 crore.
cards.impact: continued foreign buying into Diwali week supports the equity risk premium around gold-loan peers; it does not change NCD allotment maths.

cards.title: Rupee closes at 93.90; Brent settles at $98.32
cards.summary: BusinessLine reports the rupee closed at 93.90 per dollar on 6 Nov, up 57 paise from 94.47 — a six-and-a-half-month high. Brent settled at $98.32 a barrel, barely changed on the day after a sharp weekly drop.
cards.impact: a firmer rupee and softer oil ease the inflation path priced into bank funding costs for NBFCs.

cards.title: RBI publishes September NBFC sectoral credit; gold jewellery loans +66.1%
cards.summary: RBI press release (6 Nov, prid=63940): NBFC credit +15.4% YoY in Sep 2026; retail +21.9%; gold jewellery loans called out with accelerated growth. Source: RBI

cards.title: SEBI Settlement Regulations, 2026 in force from 7 Nov
cards.summary: SEBI PR No.70/2026 (6 Nov): Settlement of Administrative and Civil Proceedings Regulations, 2026 commence today; calculator and online application live. Source: SEBI

cards.title: No significant new NBFC results overnight beyond items already covered on 5–6 Nov (Muthoot Microfin Q2).

cards.section: Sector Deep Dive — Saturday: Infrastructure & project finance
cards.title: RBI: infrastructure lending at NBFCs slowed to 5.9% YoY in September
cards.summary: Inside industry credit (up 7.4% YoY to ₹22.69 lakh crore), RBI says infrastructure growth stayed subdued at 5.9% YoY to ₹20.60 lakh crore, vs 9.4% a year earlier; power lending grew 7.9% to ₹14.80 lakh crore. ETBFSI's read of the same release puts infrastructure at those levels and contrasts it with gold jewellery's 66.1% surge.
cards.impact: none direct on the gold book — system growth is rotating toward retail secured (gold, housing, vehicles) while classic infra NBFCs are the slow pocket.

cards.title: Sectoral Deployment of Credit by NBFC – September 2026

cards.impact: not a lending or gold-loan circular. It matters for any future SEBI civil or administrative exposure on listed NCDs or related intermediary conduct.

latest_circulars.title: 27 Oct 2026: SEBI HO/(201)2026-DDHS-POD1/I/24467/2026: Debenture trustees, extension for separate business units to 27 Apr 2027 (link)
Commencement of SEBI Settlement Regulations, 2026
latest_circulars.summary: SEBI PR No.70/2026 (6 Nov) confirms the Settlement Regulations, 2026 — notified 8 Oct 2026 — come into force on 7 Nov 2026. FAQs, an online settlement-amount calculator, an online application form and a help desk are available on sebi.gov.in.
latest_circulars.impact: not a lending or gold-loan circular. It matters for any future SEBI civil or administrative exposure on listed NCDs or related intermediary conduct.

latest_circulars.title: 5 Nov 2026: SEBI HO/24/13/(1)2026-IMD-POD-2/I/25242/2026: Framework for net settlement of funds for mutual-fund cash-market transactions (link)
5 Nov 2026: SEBI HO/19/34/11(6)2026-AFD-POD1/I/25244/2026: Review of the framework for Accredited Investors (link)
SEBI circulars on 5 Nov: accredited investors, MF net settlement, currency-derivatives limits
latest_circulars.summary: SEBI issued three circulars on 5 Nov: HO/19/34/11(6)2026-AFD-POD1/I/25244/2026 (accredited-investor framework), HO/24/13/(1)2026-IMD-POD-2/I/25242/2026 (net settlement of funds for mutual-fund cash-market trades), and HO/(561)2026-MRD-POD2/I/25177/2026 (currency-derivatives underlying-exposure limits). None is addressed to NBFCs as lenders.
latest_circulars.impact: none for lending or NCD disclosure. Listed only so the circulars list stays complete.

latest_circulars.title: Consolidation of Instructions Related to Priority Sector Lending – Drafts for Comments
latest_circulars.summary: RBI on 5 Nov placed five draft Priority Sector Lending Directions on its website — one each for commercial banks, small finance banks, local area banks, regional rural banks and urban co-operative banks — and invited comments by 26 Nov 2026. The drafts consolidate existing PSL targets and classification rules; ETBFSI reports they retain the overall PSL targets and the 5% cap on eligible bank lending through NBFCs for on-lending.
latest_circulars.impact: no new NBFC Direction today, but the retained 5% on-lending cap is the ceiling that shapes how much PSL-eligible bank money can reach gold and other NBFC books through the on-lending channel.

latest_circulars.title: Review of Know Your Client process for individual Person Resident Outside India clients
latest_circulars.summary: SEBI's 4 Nov circular removes the effective requirement that a non-resident individual be in India to finish KYC, so intermediaries can onboard such clients digitally. Intermediaries must pass the KYC information to a KRA within 3 working days.
latest_circulars.impact: no lending impact. Non-resident investors seeking its listed NCDs through a demat account may find onboarding easier from December.

2 Nov 2026: RBI FEMA 23(R)/(2)/2026-RB: FEMA (Export and Import of Goods and Services) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2026 (link)
FEMA (Export and Import of Goods and Services) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2026
latest_circulars.summary: RBI published Notification No. FEMA 23(R)/(2)/2026-RB dated 2 Nov 2026, the Foreign Exchange Management (Export and Import of Goods and Services) (Second Amendment) Regulations, 2026. It amends the principal regulations of 13 Jan 2026 and is stated to come into force from 1 Oct 2026.
latest_circulars.impact: none expected, as the amendment concerns export-import transactions rather than domestic lending.

latest_circulars.title: Implementation of Section 51A of UAPA, 1967: Updates to UNSC's 1988 (2011) Taliban Sanctions List: Amendment of 05 Entries
latest_circulars.summary: RBI/2026-27/303 (DoR.AML.REC.255/14.06.001/2026-27, 30 Oct) passes on the UNSC's amendments to five entries on the 1988 (2011) Taliban Sanctions List under Section 51A of UAPA.
